submittedPrompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Render ONLY a close crop of the existing DirectoryTreeSelect combobox and its open tree popup, centered on a plain white canvas. Image 1 supplies only the component tree structure; discard all surrounding host. Image 2 supplies only flat compact styling.
Single searchable combobox shows selected path 30-Knowledge / 个人知识管理 / 方法 with dropdown chevron. Immediately below, one bounded popup tree: 所有目录 root expanded; 00-Inbox collapsed; 30-Knowledge expanded; 个人知识管理 expanded; 方法 selected in light blue. Show folder icons, hierarchy indents, chevrons and thin tree guide lines, with narrow scrollbar if needed. Search is within this same editable combobox, not a separate added search box. Only browse/expand/select actions; no 确认/取消/create/delete/rename/footer buttons, no tabs or app navigation, no skeleton motifs. Flat white #ffffff main/header, #f7f8fa context sidebar, #272b3a text, #657084 muted, #e6e9f1 thin borders, #4566c6 blue and #edf1ff selection. Crisp Chinese sans-serif, 8px corners, no texture/gradient. Component source WS-023 and owner host linkage are metadata, not product text.
